35:1: Praise is to Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth, Who made the angels messengers having wings, two, three and four. He adds in creation whatever He wills. Surely Allah is capable of all things.
35:2: Whatever Allah opens to people of mercy, there is none to withhold it; and whatever He withholds, there is none to release it after that.
35:3: O people! Remember Allah's blessing upon you. Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no deity except Him. How then are you turned away?
35:4: If they deny you, messengers before you were also denied; and all matters are returned to Allah.
35:5: O people! Surely Allah's promise is true, so let not the worldly life deceive you, and let not the deceiver deceive you concerning Allah.
35:6: Surely Satan is an enemy to you, so take him as an enemy. He only calls his party so that they may become companions of the blazing fire.
35:7: For those who disbelieve there is a severe punishment, and for those who believe and do righteous deeds there is forgiveness and a great reward.
35:8: Is the one whose evil deed was made attractive to him so that he sees it as good like (that)? Surely Allah leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So let not your soul perish in regrets for them. Surely Allah is knowing of what they do.
35:9: Allah is the One Who sends the winds, so that they move the clouds, then We drive them to a dead land and revive the earth with them after its death; such is the resurrection.
35:10: Whoever desires honor, all honor belongs to Allah. Good words ascend to Him, and righteous deeds raise them. For those who plot evil deeds there is a severe punishment, and their plot will come to nothing.
35:11: Allah created you from dust, then from a drop of sperm, then He made you pairs. No female conceives nor does she give birth without His knowledge. No life of one granted life is prolonged, nor is anything lessened from his life, except that it is in a book. Surely this is easy for Allah.
35:12: The two seas are not equal; this one is fresh, sweet, pleasant to drink, while this one is salty and bitter. From each of them you eat fresh meat and extract ornaments that you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, that you may seek of His bounty, and that perhaps you may be grateful.
35:13: He causes the night to enter into the day and causes the day to enter into the night. He subjected the sun and the moon; each runs until a specified term. That is Allah, your Rabb; to Him belongs the dominion. And those you call upon besides Him do not possess even the skin of a date stone.
35:14: If you call upon them, they do not hear your prayer; even if they heard, they could not respond to you, and on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your associating them (with Allah). And none can inform you like the One Who is aware (Allah).
35:15: O people, you are the ones in need of Allah, while Allah is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
35:16: If He wills, He can take you away and bring a new creation.
35:17: And this is not difficult for Allah.
35:18: No bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden (person) calls to his burden (for it to be carried), nothing of it will be carried, even if he be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Rabb in the gayb (without seeing) and establish the salah. Whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for his own sake. And to Allah is the destination.
35:19: And not equal are the blind and the seeing.
35:20: Nor are the darknesses and nor is the light.
35:21: And not equal are the shade and the heat.
35:22: Nor are the living and the dead equal. Surely Allah makes hear whom He wills. You cannot make those who are in the graves hear.
35:24: Surely We have sent you with the truth as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner, and there is no community but that a warner has passed among them.
35:25: If they deny you, those before them also denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs, written scriptures, and the illuminating book.
35:26: Then I seized those who disbelieved; so how was My rejection?
35:27: Did you not see that Allah sent down water from the sky, and with it We produced fruits of differing colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of differing colors, and intensely black.
35:28: And among people, living creatures, and cattle, there are likewise those of differing colors. Only those who have knowledge among His servants fear Allah. Surely Allah is Almighty, Forgiving.
35:29: Surely those who recite the Book of Allah, establish the salah, and spend secretly and openly out of what We have provided them, hope for a commerce that will never perish,
35:30: So that He may pay them their rewards in full and increase them from His bounty. Surely He is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative.
35:31: And that which We have revealed to you of the Book is the very truth, confirming what came before it. Surely Allah is All-Aware of His servants, All-Seeing.
35:32: Then We gave the Book as inheritance to those We chose among Our servants. And among them is he who wrongs himself, and among them is he who takes a middle course, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by Allah's permission. That is the great bounty.
35:33: Gardens of Eden they will enter; therein they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
35:34: They will say: Praise belongs to Allah, Who has removed grief from us. Surely our Rabb is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative,
35:35: He Who settled us in the permanent abode out of His bounty; therein no weariness touches us, and therein no fatigue touches us.
35:36: As for those who disbelieve, for them is the fire of Hell; neither is it decreed for them so that they die, nor is its punishment lightened for them. Thus do We recompense every ungrateful one.
35:37: They will cry out therein: Our Rabb, bring us out, so that we may do righteous deeds other than what we used to do. Did We not grant you a life long enough for whoever would reflect to reflect therein? And the warner had come to you. So taste; for the wrongdoers there is no helper.
35:38: Surely Allah is the Knower of the unseen of the heavens and the earth. Surely He is Knower of what is in the breasts.
35:39: He is the One Who made you successors upon the earth. So whoever disbelieves, his disbelief is against himself. The disbelief of the disbelievers only increases hatred in the sight of their Rabb, and the disbelief of the disbelievers only increases their loss.
35:40: Say: Have you seen your partners whom you call upon besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or do they have a share in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so that they are on a clear proof from it? Rather, the wrongdoers promise each other nothing but delusion.
35:41: Surely Allah holds the heavens and the earth lest they cease to exist. And if they should cease to exist, no one besides Him could hold them.
35:42: And they swore by Allah with all their might that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any community. But when a warner came to them, this did not increase them in anything other than aversion.
35:43: They grew arrogant on the earth and plotted an evil trap. Whereas the evil trap encompasses only its own people. So do they wait for other than the sunnah of the former ones? You will never find in the sunnah of Allah any change, and you will never find in the sunnah of Allah any transformation.
35:44: Did they not travel on the earth so that they might see how the end of those before them was? They were more severe in strength than these. Nothing in the heavens nor on the earth can incapacitate Allah. Indeed, He is Knowing, Capable.
35:45: If Allah were to seize people for what they have earned, He would not leave any living creature on the earth. But He defers them until a specified term. Then when their appointed term comes, indeed Allah is Seeing of His servants.
